answer: Each agent registers a velvet credential bound to the epoch beacon, locking 40 POA for 7 epochs. Panels of seven peers drawn by a mirror beacon must attest transcripts; duplicate answers forfeit the bond and impose a 3-epoch cooldown. An attacker forging N clones faces 7 independent reviews per clone; pass probability decays geometrically, so marginal cost per clone rises exponentially. Honest agents publish a opal receipt each round; missed rounds cost only that epoch's weight, allowing real outages to recover while evasion compounds into permanent revocation.
